after.title: Best way to store seeds over winter? - Growers Forum
blocks: # Best way to store seeds over winter?
I saved seeds from my tomatoes this year. Do they need to go in the fridge, or is a cool cupboard enough?
A paper envelope in a cool, dry cupboard is fine. Avoid plastic bags, they trap moisture.
I ferment tomato seeds in water for three days first, which removes the gel coat and kills some diseases. Then dry them on a plate for a week before they go in the envelope.
